profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I believe that code is engineering in its purest form, and I am an engineer at heart.

SKILLS
Languages: Java, JavaScript(ES6), Python, TypeScript
Frontend: Vue.js, Vuex, ReactJS, Redux, HTML5, Sass(.scss)
Backend: Spring, MySQL, Django, Express, Node.js
DevOps: Docker, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Heroku

PORTFOLIO & GITHUB
https://anthonytummillo.com/
https://github.com/ATummillo/

Feel free to reach out!

Best,

Tony
atummillo.dev@gmail.com
(650) 241-0783

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Developed reports and analysis on customer data which aided in a 20% increase in yearly revenue.
▪ Rebuilt doctor-facing application in Vue.js with additional features that increased the ease of use for
doctors and treatment satisfaction for patients.
▪ Decreased existing reporting runtime by 95% on average.
▪ Communicated directly with executives, operations team, and designers to insure that projects
remained on track and included the necessary features to drive business value.
▪ Built Git repositories which utilized Docker to reduce project setup time for other engineers by 80%.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · Python (Programming Language) · Spring Framework · MySQL · Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Developed graphical viewing tool which allowed analysts to visually identify trends between disparate data sources.
▪ Parallelized workload by orchestrating fleet of Google Compute Engine instances which resulted in a 90% reduction in data collection intervals and boosted daily data acquisition by 12X.
▪ Developed automated scraping applications that fetched >15GB of data daily from both webpages and REST APIs using Python.
▪ Reduced cloud database storage by 85% and resource cost by $500/month through migrating
existing datastores on Microsoft SQL Server to Google BigQuery.

positions.title: Solutions Developer
positions.description:
▪ Communicated cross teams with client staff to automate manual procedures and workflows. Saved staff 15-20 hours of work per week on average.
▪ Implemented UI in 4D-IQ’s proprietary platform “Flow” allowing users to integrate with Google Cloud and Amazon Alexa Web Information Service.
▪ Optimized and maintained existing client solutions to stay up to date with external API and internal procedure changes resulting in uninterrupted automation and analytics.

positions.title: Application Development Intern
positions.description:
▪ Expanded application’s Express REST API to allow processing of GPX formatted data.
▪ Increased code base durability by automating unit testing of the application’s REST API using the Jasmine framework with Node.js

positions.title: Information Systems Development Intern
positions.description: While with AmeriHealth Caritas I was involved in developing database-backed web applications for the purpose of data visualization, developing scripts to automate processing and analysis of patient data, and developing Microsoft SharePoint team sites. The main technologies I utilized were the jQuery/CanvasJS plugin, Python, and C#/Microsoft SharePoint.

honors.title: J. Wood Platt Scholarship Recipient
honors.description: $5,000 awarded to those who show outstanding academic performance. Received every year from 2014 to graduation in 2017.
honors.issuer: Issued by J. Wood Platt Scholarship Trust · Aug 2014
